title.zh: 将位于宿务省曼达韦市描笼涯洛奥克阿·C·科尔特斯大道、延伸至拉普拉普市描笼涯帕霍曼达韦—马卡坦公路的宿务—马卡坦一号大桥命名为塞尔金·贝洛索·奥斯梅尼亚小桥的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the First Cebu-Mactan Bridge Traversing the Mactan Channel Located At A.C. Cortes Avenue in Barangay Looc, Mandaue City Up to the Mandaue-Mactan Road in Barangay Pajo, Lapu-Lapu City, Both in the Province of Cebu, as Serging Veloso Osmeña Jr. Bridge
title.orig: An Act Naming the First Cebu-Mactan Bridge Traversing the Mactan Channel Located At A.C. Cortes Avenue in Barangay Looc, Mandaue City Up to the Mandaue-Mactan Road in Barangay Pajo, Lapu-Lapu City, Both in the Province of Cebu, as Serging Veloso Osmeña Jr. Bridge
title.vi: Đạo luật đặt tên Cầu Cebu-Mactan số 1 bắc qua Kênh Mactan từ Đại lộ A.C. Cortes tại Barangay Looc, Thành phố Mandaue đến Đường Mandaue-Mactan tại Barangay Pajo, Thành phố Lapu-Lapu, cả hai đều thuộc Tỉnh Cebu là Cầu Serging Veloso Osmeña Jr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติตั้งชื่อสะพานเซบู–มาคตันหมายเลข1ซึ่งข้ามช่องแคบมาคตันจากถนนเอซีคอร์เทสในบารังไกย์ลูกถึงถนนมานดาว–มาคตันในบารังไกย์ปาโฮทั้งสองแห่งอยู่ในจังหวัดเซบูว่าสะพานเซอร์จิงเวโลโซออสมินญาจูเนียร์
title.id: Undang-Undang Penetapan Nama Jembatan Cebu-Mactan Nomor 1 yang Melintasi Saluran Mactan dari Jalan A.C. Cortes di Barangay Looc, Kota Mandaue hingga Jalan Mandaue-Mactan di Barangay Pajo, Kota Lapu-Lapu, Keduanya di Provinsi Cebu sebagai Jembatan Serging Veloso Osmeña Jr.
title.ms: Akta Menamakan Jambatan Cebu-Mactan 1 yang Melintasi Saluran Mactan dari Lebuhraya A.C. Cortes di Barangay Looc, Bandaraya Mandaue sehingga ke Lebuhraya Mandaue-Mactan di Barangay Pajo, Bandaraya Lapu-Lapu, Kedua-duanya di Wilayah Cebu sebagai Jambatan Serging Veloso Osmeña Jr.

text.en: The First Cebu-Mactan Bridge traversing the Mactan Channel located at A.C. Cortes Avenue in Barangay Looc, Mandaue City up to the Mandaue-Mactan Road in Barangay Pajo, Lapu-Lapu City, both in the Province of Cebu, comprising a total distance of 854 meters, is hereby renamed as Serging Veloso Osmeña Jr. Bridge.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
